title: Cancer: try this week
old_caption:
Cancer, hoping they'll guess what you need can leave you both stuck. Snacks? Space? A nap?
Say it out loud: "hug, please?" Asking clearly is an act of trust.

title: Capricorn: the blind spot
old_caption:
Capricorn, your drive is admirable. But under forty urgent emails, a sweet "dinner tonight?" is waiting.
Love isn't another task on the list. Let it be a place you rest.

title: Capricorn: what you need
old_caption:
Capricorn, you need a partner with their own big goals who respects yours too.
Two climbers on two peaks can still build a bridge between them. That's teamwork.

title: Capricorn: try this week
old_caption: Capricorn, try this: log off at 7, and text your person before you check that last email. Work will keep. A small "thinking of you" is how you show up where it counts.

title: Earth signs, gather round.
old_caption:
Earth signs, you grow love the way you'd tend a garden: slowly and with care. Just leave a little space for the seed you didn't plan.
Sometimes the sweetest bloom is a surprise.

title: Fire signs, gather round.
old_caption:
Fire signs, you love big and fast, and that's beautiful. But a flame needs air and time to breathe.
Let the other person catch up, and you'll burn warm instead of out.

title: Gemini: the blind spot
old_caption:
Gemini, a buzzing inbox can feel like connection, but eight half-chats rarely fill you up.
Close a few tabs and call one person. One real conversation is worth more than ten quick ones.

title: Gemini: what you need
old_caption: Gemini, you deserve someone who can keep up with your racing brain and still sits beside you when you go quiet. You don't have to choose between fun and deep. You get both.

title: Gemini: try this week
old_caption:
Gemini, here's a gentle challenge: one date, phone face down the whole time.
Watch how the evening opens up. Being fully present is something people feel right away.

title: Leo: the blind spot
old_caption: Leo, your light is wonderful. Share the spotlight. Ask about their day, then ask "and then?" Watching someone light up because you were curious is its own kind of glow.
